description: This file declares external API functions related to the Simple System Time Object for the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) system. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the system time object.

methods.name: AnscCreateSimpleSysTime
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Simple System Time object.

methods.name: AnscSstoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Simple System Time object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscSstoRemove
methods.description: Removes a specified Simple System Time object.

methods.name: AnscSstoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects or components into the Simple System Time object.

methods.name: AnscSstoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Simple System Time object.
